sloka: तीरे तु सरसो वै तु सञ्जज्ञे मानसस्य हि ।सरस्तदा मानसं तु ववृधे जलदागमे ।। ७.१२.२५ ॥
transliteration: tīre tu saraso vai tu sañjajñe mānasasya hi ।sarastadā mānasaṁ tu vavṛdhe jaladāgame ।। 7.12.25 ॥

translations.english: She was born on the bank of Lake Manasa, and at that time, during the rainy season, Lake Manasa was overflowing.
